args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The
vulnerability is fixed in 2.9.4; stay on the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

Affected versions: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in 2.9.4 and 3.1.0; this PR pins 2.9.4 to stay on the 2.x line rather than jumping to 3.x.

Only `requirements.txt` is changed; no code changes required.

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.
